description:
Rewrite gen_tailscale from scratch in Elixir, replacing the current stack:
  tailscale_transport → gen_tailscale (Erlang, forked gen_tcp_socket) → libtailscale (C NIF → Go)
with:
  tailscale_transport → gen_tailscale (clean Elixir GenServer) → ts_elixir (Rustler NIF → tailscale-rs)

Goals:
- Clean, understandable code (~500-700 lines vs ~2700)
- gen_tcp-compatible API surface (listen/accept/send/recv/setopts/controlling_process)
- SSL support via :ssl cb_info
- ThousandIsland transport (TCP + SSL)
- Thorough unit, integration, and property testing
- Upstream recv-with-length to tailscale-rs/ts_elixir

Key design decisions:
- GenServer per socket wrapping ts_elixir opaque NIF handles
- Recv buffering (ts_elixir recv has no length param)
- Active mode (:once/:true/N) with configurable message tags
- Socket options stored in GenServer state (mode, active, packet, etc.)
title: Replace gen_tailscale/libtailscale with clean Elixir rewrite on top of ts_elixir
